read.thesis: Software-led growth accelerated to 6% constant currency with pre-tax operating margin up 0.7 pts, but Consulting was flat and the 4-5% full-year guide was held, not raised; $11.4B of acquisitions drove goodwill up $7.2B.

triggers.label: FCF guide raised to +$1B+
triggers.quote: we now expect free cash flow to increase by more than $1 billion year-over-year

triggers.label: Software up 9% cc; Data +20%
triggers.quote: Software revenue up 8 percent, up 9 percent at constant currency

triggers.label: Consulting flat; IO down 2%
triggers.quote: Consulting — revenues of $5.3 billion, flat, up 2 percent at constant currency

triggers.label: IBM Z down 20%
triggers.quote: IBM Z down 20 percent, down 19 percent at constant currency

guidance.quote: The company continues to expect full-year constant currency revenue growth in the range of four-to-five percent
